method.distance: equal-weight missing-aware mixed Gower on five components derived from six original survey variables
method.pac_policy: comparative only; no universal absolute cutoff

decision.status: No sufficiently robust Branch F household-economic segmentation found

limitations: These are exploratory household-economic response profiles, not validated economic-capital classes.
Household size is used as a denominator for worker/unemployed shares rather than receiving an additional distance weight.
Income prefer-not-to-say is pairwise unavailable rather than ranked as an income level.
One respondent has only two usable components after an income refusal and an internally inconsistent household count; this record is retained and explicitly flagged.
Primary income source is nominal and may create a direct job-versus-family-support split; single-feature and structural-only sensitivity are reported.
Permutation calibration tests whether the selected structure exceeds independently shuffled variables, but it does not establish theoretical construct validity.
The Branch F sample contains only 81 valid respondents; confirmation in additional data is required.
